_meta.purpose: Complete contentpage modules. Each pattern carries its own selection metadata (intent / whenToUse / cardinality / alternatives) — there is no separate sections file.
_meta.levels: level "section" brings its own Section wrapper and is placed by a template slot. level "module" is embeddable inside another pattern and is reached via $ref.

contentpage.home-hero.purpose: Centered entry section: h1, large subline, action row.
contentpage.home-hero.intent: Open the page with the main promise and the primary action.
contentpage.home-hero.whenToUse: The page is a top-level entry point (home, campaign, product landing) and the message should be centered. Its Brand action is the page's single primary action and MUST repeat verbatim in the closing CTA.

contentpage.subpage-hero.purpose: Left-aligned entry section: h1, large subline, action row.
contentpage.subpage-hero.intent: Open a subordinate page with its title and the primary action.
contentpage.subpage-hero.whenToUse: The page sits below a top-level entry (a detail, topic or service page) and reads left-aligned like the body content that follows. Its Brand action is the page's single primary action and MUST repeat verbatim in the closing CTA.

contentpage.content-row.purpose: One 50-50 media/text row, text on the left.
contentpage.content-row.intent: Explain one point with a supporting image beside it.
contentpage.content-row.whenToUse: A single narrative step inside a content section. Alternate with the flipped variant across consecutive rows.

contentpage.content-row-flip.purpose: One 50-50 media/text row, image on the left.
contentpage.content-row-flip.intent: Explain one point with a supporting image beside it, mirrored.
contentpage.content-row-flip.whenToUse: The alternating counterpart of contentpage.content-row; use for every second row so the rhythm reads deliberate.

contentpage.content-section.purpose: Section title followed by alternating 50-50 media/text rows.
contentpage.content-section.intent: Explain a topic through a sequence of related content points.
contentpage.content-section.whenToUse: The content is a narrative, a product explanation or two to three related points that each deserve an image.

contentpage.card-section.purpose: Section title followed by three equal text-first cards.
contentpage.card-section.intent: Present three equivalent options side by side.
contentpage.card-section.whenToUse: Three equal resources, topics, services or choices, none of which needs an image. Never use it for heterogeneous content.

contentpage.visual-section.purpose: Section title followed by three image-led teasers.
contentpage.visual-section.intent: Offer three equivalent options that each need an image.
contentpage.visual-section.whenToUse: Three equal topics, destinations or offers where the picture carries the message. Use card-section instead when the items are text-only.

contentpage.visual-card-section.purpose: Section title followed by three image-led teasers on card surfaces.
contentpage.visual-card-section.intent: Offer three equivalent image-led options that should read as distinct surfaces.
contentpage.visual-card-section.whenToUse: Like visual-section, but the items need to sit on their own elevated surface — e.g. against a tinted section background.

contentpage.article-section.purpose: Section title followed by three article teasers with image, category and meta.
contentpage.article-section.intent: Offer a set of editorial articles or news entries.
contentpage.article-section.whenToUse: The content is dated, authored editorial material — news, blog posts, press. Use card-section instead when the items are non-editorial options.

contentpage.content-banner.purpose: Elevation-1 card with a 50-50 text/image split, text on the left.
contentpage.content-banner.intent: Highlight one featured item inside a surface.
contentpage.content-banner.whenToUse: A single announcement, promotion or featured topic that should stand out from the surrounding body copy.

contentpage.content-banner-flip.purpose: Elevation-1 card with a 50-50 image/text split, image on the left.
contentpage.content-banner-flip.intent: Highlight one featured item inside a surface, mirrored.
contentpage.content-banner-flip.whenToUse: The alternating counterpart of contentpage.content-banner when two banners follow each other.

contentpage.banner-section.purpose: Section wrapper around one content banner.
contentpage.banner-section.intent: Give a single featured item its own place in the page flow.
contentpage.banner-section.whenToUse: One item deserves more weight than a card in a row, but does not carry a whole section of its own content.

contentpage.cta-card.purpose: Closing card with a centered h2 and the action row.
contentpage.cta-card.intent: Close the page with the same conversion action the hero opened with.
contentpage.cta-card.whenToUse: Always, exactly once, as the final section. It repeats the hero's action with IDENTICAL labels — the same offer at the exit, not a second one.
